reviewer: independent narrative and visual review agent
scope: Inspected the listed final encoded-video stills, narration and scene source, current WAV hashes, declared cue timing, and supplied current signal/layout verification. No listening or speech-recognition review.
revisionNote: Story-led script replaces the literal UI readout. Current final MP4 and image hashes replace the prior version. The old good-flow outcome-onset assertion is removed because that line now establishes a general user experience, not a timed technical outcome.
script: A quick setting change. Back to what you were doing.
Then one tiny change… and suddenly, you’ve lost your place.
Focus Trail shows you where the journey breaks.
Catch it before your users do.

findings.check: Actual UI and both keyboard journeys visible
findings.evidence: The contact sheet visibly includes the shipped hero, the real browser workshop, an open settings modal in both journeys, and the final focus outcomes. It shows Open settings for the working flow and Document body for the controlled fault. Large Tab, Enter, Tab and Esc key labels make the path legible.

The five spoken lines introduce a shipping question, establish the normal user experience, introduce loss of place, offer Focus Trail’s diagnostic payoff, and close with a testing invitation. They do not read keyboard names, button labels, report row labels, or checkpoint numbers.

The full encoded fault still clearly shows Document body in the real application inspector and in the large outcome caption, with the controlled-fault label visible. The expected return to Open settings is visible in the good-flow contact-sheet panel.

The full report still visibly states the return-opener 500 ms checkpoint timeout and Step 8. Its observed-target row says Focus unavailable and retains the last coherent sample without a later verified sample. The caption keeps Saved report · endpoint sample unavailable visible, and the closing label says Controlled demo · Open source. No narration claims that this historical report freshly sampled BODY.

Main headlines, keys and outcome captions are large and high contrast in the inspected stills. The corner focus mark and Focus Trail brand remain visible. The full-resolution report’s checkpoint and sample-unavailability wording are legible. No visible clipping or overlapping text was found.

The native model estimate for the onset of lost is 8.9 + 2.45 = 11.35s, after the capture-derived global Escape at 11.24s. The good-flow line is a general experiential setup; no technical outcome-word timing assertion is made for it. These timings are source/model estimates, not ASR or listening evidence.

findings.check: Current story voice sources included in encoded mix
findings.evidence: The supplied current independent reconstruction compares 13 authored tracks with decoded AAC PCM. Whole-mix correlation is 0.999942; the lowest of the five voice-segment correlations is 0.999862 (required minimum 0.97). This supports source inclusion and scheduling, not perceived delivery quality.

The current check reports strict ok=true, browserSkipped=false, no lint/runtime/layout findings, 8 layout sample times and 31/31 contrast checks. Motion analysis is disabled and is not claimed as a measured pass.

narrationOutcomeTiming.method: Composition offset plus model-estimated word onset and capture-derived Escape time; not independently recognized speech.
narrationOutcomeTiming.good: General experience clause; no outcome-onset assertion.

limits: This review inspected the listed decoded stills; it did not watch every frame or certify every transition.

No audio was heard or subjectively evaluated. Spoken content comes from the synthesis script; word onsets are model estimates. Signal matching supports inclusion, not speech recognition or expressive quality.
The setting-change line supplies the user scenario; this controlled demonstration verifies dialog focus behavior and does not establish that a setting was saved.
Small secondary UI text remains small. Essential keys and outcomes are repeated in large captions; most viewers will not read the entire report during the Reel.
Instagram UI overlays and platform recompression were not tested in the Instagram app.
verdict: No blocking visual, story-scope or declared source-timing issue found in the inspected current encode. Subjective voice quality was not assessed.
